title: Camera magic: the art of special effects
creator_credit: Jerry Samuelson, Paul Burnford and Pyramid Films
brief_description: Demonstrates a variety of camera techniques which can be used to produce special effects with an ordinary 16mm or 8mm motion picture camera without employing special equipment. Shows rotation in space, multiple images, upside down and reverse action, instant appearance and disappearance of objects and people and fast and slow motion. Suitable for upper secondary level.
